question:
In Microsoft GraphRAG and Knowledge Graphs, what failure mode triggers the following observed symptom?
"Edge case trigger: 'Root Cause'"

options.text: Missing entity resolution / coreference deduplication during graph ingestion.
Degree centrality is computed by counting only the source side of each relationship triple, so hub entities that are always the target of a relation are silently ranked at zero.
The graph store deduplicates edges by relationship type alone, so two different real-world facts between the same two entities collapse into a single edge.
Community summarization runs before all documents finish being ingested, so later documents' entities never get incorporated into any community summary.

explanation: Diagnostic Analysis: Missing entity resolution / coreference deduplication during graph ingestion.

Re-run relationship extraction with a larger context window so more distant entity pairs are captured per document.
